svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a blank 640 x 460 mm from 1 mm sheet; deburr; paint it white

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (or buy pre-coated white sheet and touch up the cut edges).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark a top plate 360 mm deep and 440 mm wide in the middle of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: blank. A 100 mm flap goes along its outer edge and a 100 mm flap

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: along each side. Cut a small relief at each corner where flaps meet.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fold all three flaps 90 degrees down in a sheet folder or between

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Arms: cut two 400 mm lengths of 40 x 6 mm flat bar. Bend 40 mm of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: one end 90 degrees over a 12 mm former; drill a 6.5 mm hole in the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: middle of that wall tab. Rivet the plate to the arms (two 4 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rivets each, 100 and 250 mm from the wall end).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the tabs go on the gable wall 120 mm either side of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: enclosure's centre line, the plate's top 1,480 mm above the ground,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: level, on two M6 screws into wall plugs. The plate stands 130 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: above the box and clears the siren by about 60 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the door swings fully open under the front flap; the shade is level.
